name: NACL Industries Limited
summary: NACL Industries Limited manufactures and sells agrochemicals in India. The company offers a range of technical products, including myclobutanil, propiconazole, profenofos, tricyclazole, pretilachlors, thiamethoxam, lambda cyhalothrin, bifenthrin, azoxystrobin, tebuconazole, difenoconazole, thifluzamide, bispyribac sodium, clodinafop propargyl, metribuzin, quizalofop ethyl, haloxyfop r methyl, and glufosinate ammonium; and formulations, such as insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, and plant growth regulators and nematicides, as well as pesticides and acaricides.
